## Result

The pull request is cleared. No verified correctness, security, maintainability,
coverage, or simplification finding warranted another code change.

## Finding inventory

- Rechecked reused listener-message ownership. The top-level processing lifecycle
  resets the delivery claim, nested JMS/Spring callbacks share it, and the JMS 1.1
  and 3.0 regression tests cover repeated callbacks.
- Rechecked synchronous receive handoff and stale context cleanup. Receive state is
  attached to the physical message, preserved through the first processing
  callback, and cleared at the outer callback boundary.
- Rechecked Camel wrapping/refill and explicit suppression. Camel shares only the
  delivery-accounting state, replaces it on refill, and does not claim ownership
  when telemetry is explicitly suppressed. Dedicated tests cover these paths.
